remarks: Welcome to urban elegance in this impeccably updated 2-bedroom, 2-bath apartment offering 1,190 square feet of modern living space in a full-service amenity building. Step into a bright, open layout enhanced by gleaming hardwood floors and state-of-the-art finishes throughout. The expansive living area provides a seamless flow perfect for entertaining, while oversized windows frame serene views of the building's private park.  Retreat to your luxurious master suite complete with a sprawling walk-in closet, a spa-like en suite bathroom, and your very own private deck overlooking lush greenery a peaceful haven to unwind after a busy day. The second bedroom and bathroom provide versatile space for guests or a home office.  This exceptional residence also offers two dedicated parking spaces, ensuring convenience in the heart of the city. Residents enjoy exclusive access to a range of amenities including a doorman, a fully-equipped gym, and the tranquility of a private park. Plus, you'll love the unbeatable location just steps away from an array of shops, restaurants, and transportation options, making daily living activities a breeze.  12 month + lease term. Tenant pays utilities. Renters insurance required.
